lower-case-kebab: `#monoid`, `#ring-additive-ag`, etc.

### abelian-group
<a id="abelian-group"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/abelian-group.scm`](../structure-library/abelian-group.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (4): `carr` carrier; `opr` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `iden` constant in carr; `inv` operation carr -> carr.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-abelian-group-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-abelian-group(a, b, f) iff is-abelian-group(a) and is-abelian-group(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((inv(a))(x1_)) = (inv(b))(f(x1_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure abelian-group
  (carriers carr)
  (op opr (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (constant iden carr)
  (op inv carr carr)
  (property is-associative opr carr)
  (property is-identity opr iden carr)
  (property has-inverses opr iden inv carr)
  (property is-commutative opr carr))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-abelian-group` — forall([s], is-abelian-group(s) iff length(s) = 4 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and inv(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(opr(s), iden(s), inv(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(opr(s), carr(s)) and s in set)

- `ring-additive-ag` — from `ring`: (carr add zero neg) ↦ (carr opr iden inv)

- `commutative-ring-additive-ag` — from `commutative-ring`: (carr add zero neg) ↦ (carr opr iden inv)

- `field-additive-ag` — from `field`: (carr add zero neg) ↦ (carr opr iden inv)

### bundle
<a id="bundle"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/strand-spaces.scm`](../structure-library/strand-spaces.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (3): `bspace` substructure, a strand-space; `bnodes` carrier; `bsend` relation on bnodes.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-bundle-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-bundle(a, b, f) iff is-bundle(a) and is-bundle(b) and f in fun(bnodes(a), bnodes(b)) and bspace(a) = bspace(b) and forall([x1_ in bnodes(a), x2_ in bnodes(a)], [x1_, x2_] in bsend(a) implies [f(x1_), f(x2_)] in bsend(b)))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure bundle
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure bspace strand-space)
  (carriers bnodes)
  (relation bsend bnodes)
  (law (forall ssx_ (implies (in ssx_ (bnodes s)) (in ssx_ (nodes (bspace s))))))
  (law (in (card (bnodes s)) nn))
  (law (forall ssx_ (forall ssy_ (implies (in (list ssx_ ssy_) (bsend s)) (sends-to (bspace s) ssx_ ssy_)))))
  (law (forall ssy_ (implies (in ssy_ (bnodes s)) (implies (is-received (bspace s) ssy_) (forsome ssx_ (and (in (list ssx_ ssy_) (bsend s)) (forall ssz_ (implies (in (list ssz_ ssy_) (bsend s)) (= ssz_ ssx_)))))))))
  (law (forall ssy_ (implies (in ssy_ (bnodes s)) (forall ssx_ (implies (same-strand-before (bspace s) ssx_ ssy_) (in ssx_ (bnodes s)))))))
  (law (forall ssx_ (not (in (list ssx_ ssx_) (prec-strict (bspace s) (bnodes s) (bsend s)))))))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

### c-metric-space
<a id="c-metric-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/c-metric-space.scm`](../structure-library/c-metric-space.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (2): `pts` carrier; `dists` operation nn -> fun(cartesian(pts, pts), rr).

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-c-metric-space-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-c-metric-space(a, b, f) iff is-c-metric-space(a) and is-c-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forall([x1_ in nn], (dists(a))(x1_) = (dists(b))(x1_)))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure c-metric-space
  (instance-var s)
  (carriers pts)
  (op dists nn (fun (cartesian pts pts) rr))
  (law "forall([k_ in nn], is-pseudometric(dists(s)(k_), pts(s)))")
  (law "forall([u in pts(s), v in pts(s)],
          forall([k_ in nn], dists(s)(k_)(u, v) = 0) implies u = v)"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

### comm-monoid
<a id="comm-monoid"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/monoid.scm`](../structure-library/monoid.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (3): `carr` carrier; `opr` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `iden` constant in carr.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-comm-monoid-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-comm-monoid(a, b, f) iff is-comm-monoid(a) and is-comm-monoid(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure comm-monoid
  (carriers carr)
  (op opr (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (constant iden carr)
  (property is-associative opr carr)
  (property is-identity opr iden carr)
  (property is-commutative opr carr))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-comm-monoid` — forall([s], is-comm-monoid(s) iff length(s) = 3 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(opr(s), carr(s)) and s in set)

*Theorems quantifying over `is-comm-monoid`.*

- `comm-monoid-assoc` — forall([s], is-comm-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c) = (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c))))
- `comm-monoid-assoc-rev` — forall([s], is-comm-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c)) = (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c)))
- `comm-monoid-carrier-closed-opr` — forall([s], is-comm-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a, b) in carr(s)))
- `comm-monoid-identity-in-carr` — forall([s], is-comm-monoid(s) implies iden(s) in carr(s))

### commutative-banach-algebra
<a id="commutative-banach-algebra"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/ba-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/ba-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as unital-banach-algebra)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`unital-banach-algebra`](#unital-banach-algebra).  Shape inherited from `unital-banach-algebra` — slots (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act vnrm vmul vone).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure commutative-banach-algebra
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as unital-banach-algebra)
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], vmul(s)(x_, y_) = vmul(s)(y_, x_))"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-commutative-banach-algebra-def` — forall([s], is-commutative-banach-algebra(s) iff is-unital-banach-algebra(s) and forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (vmul(s))(x_, y_) = (vmul(s))(y_, x_)))

### commutative-c-star-algebra
<a id="commutative-c-star-algebra"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/ba-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/ba-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as unital-c-star-algebra)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`unital-c-star-algebra`](#unital-c-star-algebra).  Shape inherited from `unital-c-star-algebra` — slots (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act vnrm vmul vone vstar).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure commutative-c-star-algebra
  (instance-var s)
```

### complex-banach-algebra
<a id="complex-banach-algebra"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/ba-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/ba-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as complex-normed-algebra)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`complex-normed-algebra`](#complex-normed-algebra).  Shape inherited from `complex-normed-algebra` — slots (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act vnrm vmul).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure complex-banach-algebra
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as complex-normed-algebra)
  (law "is-complete(nag-metric-space(cna-as-normed-ag(s)))"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-complex-banach-algebra-def` — forall([s], is-complex-banach-algebra(s) iff is-complex-normed-algebra(s) and is-complete(nag-metric-space(cna-as-normed-ag(s))))

*Theorems quantifying over `is-complex-banach-algebra`.*

- `bal-cba-complete` — forall([a], is-complex-banach-algebra(a) implies is-complete(nag-metric-space(cna-as-normed-ag(a))))
- `bal-cba-is-cna` — forall([a], is-complex-banach-algebra(a) implies is-complex-normed-algebra(a))

### complex-inner-product-space
<a id="complex-inner-product-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/complex-inner-product.scm`](../structure-library/complex-inner-product.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (7): `scal` substructure, a ring; `vec` carrier; `vadd` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `vzero` constant in vec; `vneg` operation vec -> vec; `act` operation cartesian(carr(scal), vec) -> vec; `ip` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> cc.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-complex-inner-product-space-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-complex-inner-product-space(a, b, f) iff is-complex-inner-product-space(a) and is-complex-inner-product-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], (ip(a))(x1_, x2_) = (ip(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure complex-inner-product-space
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (op ip (cartesian vec vec) cc)
  (property is-associative vadd vec)
  (property is-commutative vadd vec)
  (property is-identity vadd vzero vec)
  (property has-inverses vadd vzero vneg vec)
  (law "scal(s) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)")
  (law "carr(scal(s)) = cc")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(r_, vadd(s)(x_, y_)) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(r_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(add(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(mul(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = act(s)(r_, act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], act(s)(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s), z_ in vec(s)],
          ip(s)(vadd(s)(x_, y_), z_) = ip(s)(x_, z_) + ip(s)(y_, z_))")
  (law "forall([a_ in cc, x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          ip(s)(act(s)(a_, x_), y_) = a_ * ip(s)(x_, y_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          ip(s)(y_, x_) = conjugate(ip(s)(x_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], ip(s)(x_, x_) in rr)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], 0 <= ip(s)(x_, x_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], (ip(s)(x_, x_) = 0) iff (x_ = vzero(s)))"))
```

### complex-normed-algebra
<a id="complex-normed-algebra"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/ba-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/ba-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (8): `scal` substructure, a ring; `vec` carrier; `vadd` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `vzero` constant in vec; `vneg` operation vec -> vec; `act` operation cartesian(carr(scal), vec) -> vec; `vnrm` operation vec -> rr; `vmul` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-complex-normed-algebra-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-complex-normed-algebra(a, b, f) iff is-complex-normed-algebra(a) and is-complex-normed-algebra(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(x1_) = (vnrm(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vmul(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vmul(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure complex-normed-algebra
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (op vnrm vec rr)
  (op vmul (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (property is-associative vadd vec)
  (property is-commutative vadd vec)
  (property is-identity vadd vzero vec)
  (property has-inverses vadd vzero vneg vec)
  (law "scal(s) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)")
  (law "carr(scal(s)) = cc")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(r_, vadd(s)(x_, y_)) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(r_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(add(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(mul(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = act(s)(r_, act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], act(s)(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], 0 <= vnrm(s)(x_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s)(x_) = 0) iff (x_ = vzero(s)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          vnrm(s)(act(s)(r_, x_)) = magnitude(r_) * vnrm(s)(x_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          vnrm(s)(vadd(s)(x_, y_)) <= vnrm(s)(x_) + vnrm(s)(y_))")
  (property is-associative vmul vec)
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s), z_ in vec(s)],
          vmul(s)(x_, vadd(s)(y_, z_)) = vadd(s)(vmul(s)(x_, y_), vmul(s)(x_, z_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s), z_ in vec(s)],
          vmul(s)(vadd(s)(x_, y_), z_) = vadd(s)(vmul(s)(x_, z_), vmul(s)(y_, z_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          vmul(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), y_) = act(s)(r_, vmul(s)(x_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          vmul(s)(x_, act(s)(r_, y_)) = act(s)(r_, vmul(s)(x_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          vnrm(s)(vmul(s)(x_, y_)) <= vnrm(s)(x_) * vnrm(s)(y_))"))
```

### complex-normed-vector-space
<a id="complex-normed-vector-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/cnvs-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/cnvs-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (8): `scal` substructure, a ring; `vec` carrier; `vadd` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `vzero` constant in vec; `vneg` operation vec -> vec; `act` operation cartesian(carr(scal), vec) -> vec; `vnrm` operation vec -> rr; `jop` operation vec -> vec.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-complex-normed-vector-space-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-complex-normed-vector-space(a, b, f) iff is-complex-normed-vector-space(a) and is-complex-normed-vector-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(x1_) = (vnrm(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((jop(a))(x1_)) = (jop(b))(f(x1_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure complex-normed-vector-space
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (op vnrm vec rr)
  (op jop vec vec)
  (law "is-normed-vector-space([scal(s), vec(s), vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), act(s), vnrm(s)])")
  (law "is-real-linear-op(s, jop(s))")
  (law "is-square-minus-id(s, jop(s))")
  (law "forall([cnc_ in cc, cnx_ in vec(s)], vnrm(s)(cact(s)(cnc_, cnx_)) = magnitude(cnc_) * vnrm(s)(cnx_))"))
```

- `is-complex-normed-vector-space` — forall([s], is-complex-normed-vector-space(s) iff length(s) = 8 and is-ring(scal(s)) and vec(s) in set and vadd(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vzero(s) in vec(s) and vneg(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and act(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(scal(s)), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vnrm(s) in fun(vec(s), rr) and jop(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and is-normed-vector-space([scal(s), vec(s), vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), act(s), vnrm(s)]) and is-real-linear-op(s, jop(s)) and is-square-minus-id(s, jop(s)) and forall([cnc_ in cc, cnx_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s))((cact(s))(cnc_, cnx_)) = magnitude(cnc_) * (vnrm(s))(cnx_)) and s in set)

### complex-pre-hilbert-space
<a id="complex-pre-hilbert-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/sip-complex-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/sip-complex-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as complex-semi-inner-product-space)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`complex-semi-inner-product-space`](#complex-semi-inner-product-space).  Shape inherited from `complex-semi-inner-product-space` — slots (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act rip jop).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure complex-pre-hilbert-space
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as complex-semi-inner-product-space)
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], rip(s)(x_, x_) = 0 implies x_ = vzero(s))"))
```

### directed-set
<a id="directed-set"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/nets.scm`](../structure-library/nets.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (2): `pts` carrier; `dleq` relation on pts.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-directed-set-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-directed-set(a, b, f) iff is-directed-set(a) and is-directed-set(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forall([x1_ in pts(a), x2_ in pts(a)], [x1_, x2_] in dleq(a) implies [f(x1_), f(x2_)] in dleq(b)))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure directed-set
  (instance-var s)
  (carriers pts)
  (relation dleq pts)
  (law (forsome dsn_ (in dsn_ (pts s))))
  (law (forall dsa_ (implies (in dsa_ (pts s)) (in (list dsa_ dsa_) (dleq s)))))
  (law (forall dsa_ (implies (in dsa_ (pts s)) (forall dsb_ (implies (in dsb_ (pts s)) (forall dsc_ (implies (in dsc_ (pts s)) (implies (in (list dsa_ dsb_) (dleq s)) (implies (in (list dsb_ dsc_) (dleq s)) (in (list dsa_ dsc_) (dleq s)))))))))))
  (law (forall dsa_ (implies (in dsa_ (pts s)) (forall dsb_ (implies (in dsb_ (pts s)) (forsome dsc_ (and (in dsc_ (pts s)) (and (in (list dsa_ dsc_) (dleq s)) (in (list dsb_ dsc_) (dleq s)))))))))))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-directed-set` — forall([s], is-directed-set(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and dleq(s) in power(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s))) and forsome([dsn_], dsn_ in pts(s)) and forall([dsa_ in pts(s)], [dsa_, dsa_] in dleq(s)) and forall([dsa_ in pts(s), dsb_ in pts(s), dsc_ in pts(s)], [dsa_, dsb_] in dleq(s) implies [dsb_, dsc_] in dleq(s) implies [dsa_, dsc_] in dleq(s)) and forall([dsa_ in pts(s), dsb_ in pts(s)], forsome([dsc_ in pts(s)], [dsa_, dsc_] in dleq(s) and [dsb_, dsc_] in dleq(s))) and s in set)

*Theorems quantifying over `is-directed-set`.*

- `ds-nonempty` — forall([d], is-directed-set(d) implies forsome([dsn_], dsn_ in pts(d)))
- `ds-refl` — forall([d], is-directed-set(d) implies forall([dsa_ in pts(d)], [dsa_, dsa_] in dleq(d)))
- `ds-trans` — forall([d], is-directed-set(d) implies forall([dsa_ in pts(d), dsb_ in pts(d), dsc_ in pts(d)], [dsa_, dsb_] in dleq(d) implies [dsb_, dsc_] in dleq(d) implies [dsa_, dsc_] in dleq(d)))
- `ds-upper` — forall([d], is-directed-set(d) implies forall([dsa_ in pts(d), dsb_ in pts(d)], forsome([dsc_ in pts(d)], [dsa_, dsc_] in dleq(d) and [dsb_, dsc_] in dleq(d))))
- `is-directed-set-is-set` — forall([s], is-directed-set(s) implies s in set)

### euclidean-ring
<a id="euclidean-ring"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/euclidean-ring.scm`](../structure-library/euclidean-ring.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as integral-domain)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`integral-domain`](#integral-domain).  Shape inherited from `integral-domain` — slots (carr add mul neg zero one).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure euclidean-ring
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as integral-domain)
  (law "forsome([dg in fun(carr(s), nn)],
          forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)],
            not(b = zero(s)) implies
              forsome([q in carr(s), r in carr(s)],
                a = add(s)(mul(s)(q, b), r)
                and (r = zero(s) or succ(dg(r)) <= dg(b)))))"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-euclidean-ring-def` — forall([s], is-euclidean-ring(s) iff is-integral-domain(s) and forsome([dg in fun(carr(s), nn)], forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], not(b = zero(s)) implies forsome([q in carr(s), r in carr(s)], a = (add(s))((mul(s))(q, b), r) and (r = zero(s) or succ(dg(r)) <= dg(b))))))

*Theorems quantifying over `is-euclidean-ring`.*

- `class-min-pivot` — forall([a], is-euclidean-ring(a) implies forall([m, n, p in mat(m, n, carr(a))], 1 in interval(1, m) implies 1 in interval(1, n) implies forsome([i0, j0], i0 in interval(1, m) and j0 in interval(1, n) and not(entry(p, i0, j0) = zero(a))) implies forsome([b], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, b) and not(entry(b, 1, 1) = zero(a)) and forall([c], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, c) implies forall([i, j], i in interval(1, m) implies j in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(c, i, j) = zero(a)) implies (gauge(a))(entry(b, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(a))(entry(c, i, j)))))))
- `clear-col-upto` — forall([a], is-euclidean-ring(a) implies forall([m, n, p in mat(m, n, carr(a))], 1 in interval(1, m) implies 1 in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(p, 1, 1) = zero(a)) implies forall([c], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, c) implies forall([ii, jj], ii in interval(1, m) implies jj in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(c, ii, jj) = zero(a)) implies (gauge(a))(entry(p, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(a))(entry(c, ii, jj)))) implies forall([k in nn], forsome([q in mat(m, n, carr(a))], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, q) and entry(q, 1, 1) = entry(p, 1, 1) and forall([i in interval(1, m)], not(i = 1) implies i <= k implies entry(q, i, 1) = zero(a)) and forall([c in interval(1, n)], entry(q, 1, c) = entry(p, 1, c))))))
- `clear-first-col` — forall([a], is-euclidean-ring(a) implies forall([m, n, p in mat(m, n, carr(a))], m in nn implies n in nn implies 1 in interval(1, m) implies 1 in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(p, 1, 1) = zero(a)) implies forall([c], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, c) implies forall([ii, jj], ii in interval(1, m) implies jj in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(c, ii, jj) = zero(a)) implies (gauge(a))(entry(p, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(a))(entry(c, ii, jj)))) implies forsome([q], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, q) and entry(q, 1, 1) = entry(p, 1, 1) and forall([i in interval(1, m)], not(i = 1) implies entry(q, i, 1) = zero(a)) and forall([c in interval(1, n)], entry(q, 1, c) = entry(p, 1, c)))))
- `clear-first-row` — forall([a], is-euclidean-ring(a) implies forall([m, n, p in mat(m, n, carr(a))], m in nn implies n in nn implies 1 in interval(1, m) implies 1 in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(p, 1, 1) = zero(a)) implies forall([c], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, c) implies forall([ii, jj], ii in interval(1, m) implies jj in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(c, ii, jj) = zero(a)) implies (gauge(a))(entry(p, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(a))(entry(c, ii, jj)))) implies forsome([q], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, q) and entry(q, 1, 1) = entry(p, 1, 1) and forall([j in interval(1, n)], not(j = 1) implies entry(q, 1, j) = zero(a)))))
- `clear-pivot-cross` — forall([a], is-euclidean-ring(a) implies forall([p, q, m], p in nn implies q in nn implies m in mat(succ(p), succ(q), carr(a)) implies forsome([i0, j0], i0 in interval(1, succ(p)) and j0 in interval(1, succ(q)) and not(entry(m, i0, j0) = zero(a))) implies forsome([c2], mat-equiv(a, succ(p), succ(q), m, c2) and c2 = border(a, entry(c2, 1, 1), submat(c2, p, q), p, q) and not(entry(c2, 1, 1) = zero(a)))))
- `clear-row-upto` — forall([a], is-euclidean-ring(a) implies forall([m, n, p in mat(m, n, carr(a))], 1 in interval(1, m) implies 1 in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(p, 1, 1) = zero(a)) implies forall([c], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, c) implies forall([ii, jj], ii in interval(1, m) implies jj in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(c, ii, jj) = zero(a)) implies (gauge(a))(entry(p, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(a))(entry(c, ii, jj)))) implies forall([k in nn], forsome([q in mat(m, n, carr(a))], mat-equiv(a, m, n, p, q) and entry(q, 1, 1) = entry(p, 1, 1) and forall([j in interval(1, n)], not(j = 1) implies j <= k implies entry(q, 1, j) = zero(a))))))
- `euclid-lemma-euclidean-ring` — forall([s], is-euclidean-ring(s) implies forall([p], is-prime-element(s, p) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], divides(s, p, (mul(s))(a, b)) implies divides(s, p, a) or divides(s, p, b))))

- `euclidean-ideal-has-generator` — forall([s], is-euclidean-ring(s) implies forall([i], is-ideal(s, i) implies forsome([b in i], forall([a in i], a in principal-ideal(s, b)))))

### field
<a id="field"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/field.scm`](../structure-library/field.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (8): `carr` carrier; `add` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `mul` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `neg` operation carr -> carr; `zero` constant in carr; `one` constant in carr; `non-zero` derived carrier, carved out of carr; `mul-inv` operation non-zero -> non-zero.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-field-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-field(a, b, f) iff is-field(a) and is-field(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((add(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (add(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((mul(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (mul(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((neg(a))(x1_)) = (neg(b))(f(x1_))) and f(zero(a)) = zero(b) and f(one(a)) = one(b) and forall([x1_ in non-zero(a)], f((mul-inv(a))(x1_)) = (mul-inv(b))(f(x1_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure field
  (instance-var s)
  (carriers carr)
  (op add (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (op mul (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (op neg carr carr)
  (constant zero carr)
  (constant one carr)
  (derived non-zero carr (difference carr (singleton zero)))
  (op mul-inv non-zero non-zero)
  (property is-associative add carr)
  (property is-commutative add carr)
  (property is-identity add zero carr)
  (property has-inverses add zero neg carr)
  (property is-associative mul carr)
  (property is-commutative mul carr)
  (property is-identity mul one carr)
  (property is-distributive add mul carr)
  (law "not(zero(s) = one(s))")
  (law "forall([a_ in non-zero(s)], mul(s)(a_, mul-inv(s)(a_)) = one(s))"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-field` — forall([s], is-field(s) iff length(s) = 8 and carr(s) in set and add(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and mul(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and neg(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and zero(s) in carr(s) and one(s) in carr(s) and non-zero(s) in set and non-zero(s) = difference(carr(s), singleton(zero(s))) and mul-inv(s) in fun(non-zero(s), non-zero(s)) and is-associative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(add(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(add(s), zero(s), neg(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(mul(s), one(s), carr(s)) and is-distributive(add(s), mul(s), carr(s)) and not(zero(s) = one(s)) and forall([a_ in non-zero(s)], (mul(s))(a_, (mul-inv(s))(a_)) = one(s)) and s in set)

### field-ring
<a id="field-ring"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/field.scm`](../structure-library/field.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as commutative-ring)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`commutative-ring`](#commutative-ring).  Shape inherited from `commutative-ring` — slots (carr add mul neg zero one).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure field-ring
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as commutative-ring)
  (law "not(one(s) = zero(s))")
  (law "forall([a_ in carr(s)],
          not(a_ = zero(s)) implies
            forsome([b_ in carr(s)], mul(s)(a_, b_) = one(s)))"))
```

### group
<a id="group"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/group.scm`](../structure-library/group.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (4): `carr` carrier; `opr` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `iden` constant in carr; `inv` operation carr -> carr.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-group-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-group(a, b, f) iff is-group(a) and is-group(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((inv(a))(x1_)) = (inv(b))(f(x1_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure group
  (carriers carr)
  (op opr (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (constant iden carr)
  (op inv carr carr)
  (property is-associative opr carr)
  (property is-identity opr iden carr)
  (property has-inverses opr iden inv carr))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-group` — forall([s], is-group(s) iff length(s) = 4 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and inv(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(opr(s), iden(s), inv(s), carr(s)) and s in set)

*Theorems quantifying over `is-group`.*

- `cyclic-product-generator` — forall([ga], is-group(ga) implies forall([gb], is-group(gb) implies card(carr(ga)) in nn implies card(carr(gb)) in nn implies forall([xa], is-generator(ga, xa) implies forall([xb], is-generator(gb, xb) implies is-generator(group-prod(ga, gb), [xa, xb]) iff zz-coprime(card(carr(ga)), card(carr(gb)))))))
- `cyclic-product-generator-rev` — forall([ga], is-group(ga) implies forall([gb], is-group(gb) implies card(carr(ga)) in nn implies card(carr(gb)) in nn implies forall([xa], is-generator(ga, xa) implies forall([xb], is-generator(gb, xb) implies zz-coprime(card(carr(ga)), card(carr(gb))) iff is-generator(group-prod(ga, gb), [xa, xb])))))
- `element-order-divides-card` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies forall([x in carr(g)], card(carr(g)) in nn implies forall([d], is-element-order(g, x, d) implies zz-divides(d, card(carr(g))))))
- `element-order-exists` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies forall([x in carr(g)], card(carr(g)) in nn implies forsome([eoo_], is-element-order(g, x, eoo_))))
- `element-order-unique` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies forall([x in carr(g), d, e], is-element-order(g, x, d) implies is-element-order(g, x, e) implies d = e))
- `element-order-unique-rev` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies forall([x in carr(g), d, e], is-element-order(g, x, d) implies is-element-order(g, x, e) implies e = d))
- `finite-group-cyclic-criterion` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies card(carr(g)) in nn implies forall([hd_ in nn], 1 <= hd_ implies card({hy_ in carr(g): gpow(g, hy_, hd_) = iden(g)}) <= hd_) implies forsome([cgx_], is-generator(g, cgx_)))
- `generator-count` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies forall([x in carr(g)], card(carr(g)) in nn implies is-generator(g, x) implies card({gny_ in carr(g): is-generator(g, gny_)}) = euler-phi(card(carr(g)))))

- `generator-order-card` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies forall([x in carr(g)], card(carr(g)) in nn implies is-generator(g, x) implies forall([d], is-element-order(g, x, d) implies card(carr(g)) = d)))
- `generator-order-card-rev` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies forall([x in carr(g)], card(carr(g)) in nn implies is-generator(g, x) implies forall([d], is-element-order(g, x, d) implies d = card(carr(g)))))
- `generator-power-iff` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies forall([x in carr(g), n], is-element-order(g, x, n) implies is-generator(g, x) implies forall([k in zz], is-generator(g, group-zpow(g, x, k)) iff zz-coprime(k, n))))

- `gpow-period-exists` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies forall([x in carr(g)], card(carr(g)) in nn implies forsome([gpd_ in nn], 1 <= gpd_ and gpow(g, x, gpd_) = iden(g))))
- `group-assoc` — forall([s], is-group(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c) = (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c))))

### infiltrated-space
<a id="infiltrated-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/strand-adversary.scm`](../structure-library/strand-adversary.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (3): `ispace` substructure, a strand-space; `adv-ids` carrier; `adv-tokens` carrier.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-infiltrated-space-def`): forall([a, b, f1, f2], is-hom-infiltrated-space(a, b, f1, f2) iff is-infiltrated-space(a) and is-infiltrated-space(b) and f1 in fun(adv-ids(a), adv-ids(b)) and f2 in fun(adv-tokens(a), adv-tokens(b)) and ispace(a) = ispace(b))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure infiltrated-space
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure ispace strand-space)
  (carriers adv-ids adv-tokens)
  (law (forall sap_ (implies (in sap_ (adv-ids s)) (in sap_ (ids (ispace s))))))
  (law (forall sat_ (implies (in sat_ (adv-tokens s)) (in sat_ (tokens (ispace s))))))
  (law (forall sap_ (implies (in sap_ (adv-ids s)) (is-adversary-trace (ispace s) (adv-tokens s) ((strand-map (ispace s)) sap_))))))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-infiltrated-space` — forall([s], is-infiltrated-space(s) iff length(s) = 3 and is-strand-space(ispace(s)) and adv-ids(s) in set and adv-tokens(s) in set and forall([sap_ in adv-ids(s)], sap_ in ids(ispace(s))) and forall([sat_ in adv-tokens(s)], sat_ in tokens(ispace(s))) and forall([sap_ in adv-ids(s)], is-adversary-trace(ispace(s), adv-tokens(s), (strand-map(ispace(s)))(sap_))) and s in set)

*Theorems quantifying over `is-infiltrated-space`.*

- `is-infiltrated-space-is-set` — forall([s], is-infiltrated-space(s) implies s in set)

### integral-domain
<a id="integral-domain"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/integral-domain.scm`](../structure-library/integral-domain.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as commutative-ring)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`commutative-ring`](#commutative-ring).  Shape inherited from `commutative-ring` — slots (carr add mul neg zero one).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure integral-domain
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as commutative-ring)
  (law "not(one(s) = zero(s))")
  (law "forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)],
          mul(s)(a, b) = zero(s) implies (a = zero(s) or b = zero(s)))"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-integral-domain-def` — forall([s], is-integral-domain(s) iff is-commutative-ring(s) and not(one(s) = zero(s)) and forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], (mul(s))(a, b) = zero(s) implies a = zero(s) or b = zero(s)))

*Theorems quantifying over `is-integral-domain`.*

- `finite-domain-characteristic` — forall([c4r], is-integral-domain(c4r) implies card(carr(c4r)) in nn implies forsome([c4p], has-characteristic(c4r, c4p)))
- `frobenius-injective` — forall([r], is-integral-domain(r) implies forall([p], has-characteristic(r, p) implies forall([a in carr(r), b in carr(r)], ring-power(r, a, p) = ring-power(r, b, p) implies a = b)))
- `frobenius-injective-rev` — forall([r], is-integral-domain(r) implies forall([p], has-characteristic(r, p) implies forall([a in carr(r), b in carr(r)], ring-power(r, a, p) = ring-power(r, b, p) implies b = a)))
- `hom-integral-domain-id` — forall([a], is-integral-domain(a) implies is-hom-integral-domain(a, a, id-fun(carr(a))))
- `integral-domain-cancel-right` — forall([s], is-integral-domain(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], not(c = zero(s)) implies (mul(s))(a, c) = (mul(s))(b, c) implies a = b))
- `integral-domain-cancel-right-rev` — forall([s], is-integral-domain(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], not(c = zero(s)) implies (mul(s))(a, c) = (mul(s))(b, c) implies b = a))
- `integral-domain-cancel-zero` — forall([s], is-integral-domain(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], (mul(s))(a, b) = zero(s) implies not(b = zero(s)) implies a = zero(s)))
- `integral-domain-cancel-zero-rev` — forall([s], is-integral-domain(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], (mul(s))(a, b) = zero(s) implies not(b = zero(s)) implies zero(s) = a))
- `integral-domain-is-commutative-ring` — forall([s], is-integral-domain(s) implies is-commutative-ring(s))
- `integral-domain-nontrivial` — forall([s], is-integral-domain(s) implies not(one(s) = zero(s)))
- `is-integral-domain-is-set` — forall([s], is-integral-domain(s) implies s in set)
- `laurent-abs-mul` — forall([kq_], is-integral-domain(kq_) implies forall([rq_ in rr], 0 < rq_ implies forall([fq_ in laurent-set(kq_), gq_ in laurent-set(kq_)], laurent-abs(kq_, rq_, laurent-mul(kq_, fq_, gq_)) = laurent-abs(kq_, rq_, fq_) * laurent-abs(kq_, rq_, gq_))))
- `laurent-abs-mul-rev` — forall([kq_], is-integral-domain(kq_) implies forall([rq_ in rr], 0 < rq_ implies forall([fq_ in laurent-set(kq_), gq_ in laurent-set(kq_)], laurent-abs(kq_, rq_, fq_) * laurent-abs(kq_, rq_, gq_) = laurent-abs(kq_, rq_, laurent-mul(kq_, fq_, gq_)))))
- `laurent-ord-mul` — forall([kq_], is-integral-domain(kq_) implies forall([fq_ in laurent-set(kq_), gq_ in laurent-set(kq_), oq_, or_], oq_ in zz and not(fq_(oq_) = zero(kq_)) and forall([lzj in zz], lzj < oq_ implies fq_(lzj) = zero(kq_)) implies or_ in zz and not(gq_(or_) = zero(kq_)) and forall([lzj in zz], lzj < or_ implies gq_(lzj) = zero(kq_)) implies oq_ + or_ in zz and not((laurent-mul(kq_, fq_, gq_))(oq_ + or_) = zero(kq_)) and forall([lzj in zz], lzj < oq_ + or_ implies (laurent-mul(kq_, fq_, gq_))(lzj) = zero(kq_))))
- `laurent-ord-mul-eq` — forall([kq_], is-integral-domain(kq_) implies forall([fq_ in laurent-set(kq_), gq_ in laurent-set(kq_)], not(fq_ = laurent-zero(kq_)) implies not(gq_ = laurent-zero(kq_)) implies not(laurent-mul(kq_, fq_, gq_) = laurent-zero(kq_)) and laurent-ord(kq_, laurent-mul(kq_, fq_, gq_)) = laurent-ord(kq_, fq_) + laurent-ord(kq_, gq_)))
- `mutual-divides-associated` — forall([s], is-integral-domain(s) implies forall([a, b], divides(s, a, b) implies divides(s, b, a) implies associated(s, a, b)))

- `poly-mul-deg` — forall([a_], is-integral-domain(a_) implies forall([f_ in carr(poly(a_))], not(f_ = zero(poly(a_))) implies forall([g_ in carr(poly(a_))], not(g_ = zero(poly(a_))) implies not((mul(poly(a_)))(f_, g_) = zero(poly(a_))) and deg(a_, (mul(poly(a_)))(f_, g_)) = deg(a_, f_) + deg(a_, g_))))
- `triv-abs-mul` — forall([kq_], is-integral-domain(kq_) implies forall([a5x in carr(kq_), a5y in carr(kq_)], triv-abs(kq_, (mul(kq_))(a5x, a5y)) = triv-abs(kq_, a5x) * triv-abs(kq_, a5y)))
- `triv-abs-mul-rev` — forall([kq_], is-integral-domain(kq_) implies forall([a5x in carr(kq_), a5y in carr(kq_)], triv-abs(kq_, a5x) * triv-abs(kq_, a5y) = triv-abs(kq_, (mul(kq_))(a5x, a5y))))

### measurable-space

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (2): `pts` carrier; `sigma` family of subsets of pts.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-measurable-space-def`): forall([s, t, f], is-hom-measurable-space(s, t, f) iff is-measurable-space(s) and is-measurable-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and forall([u in sigma(t)], preimage(s, f, u) in sigma(s)))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure measurable-space
  (instance-var s)
  (carriers pts)
  (family sigma pts)
  (law (is-sigma-algebra (pts s) (sigma s))))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-measurable-space` — forall([s], is-measurable-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and sigma(s) in power(power(pts(s))) and is-sigma-algebra(pts(s), sigma(s)) and s in set)

*Theorems quantifying over `is-measurable-space`.*

- `hom-measurable-space-id` — forall([a], is-measurable-space(a) implies is-hom-measurable-space(a, a, id-fun(pts(a))))

### metrizable-top-space
<a id="metrizable-top-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/top-space.scm`](../structure-library/top-space.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as top-space)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`top-space`](#top-space).  Shape inherited from `top-space` — slots (pts opens).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure metrizable-top-space
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as top-space)
  (law (forsome md (and (in md set) (and (is-metric-space md) (== s (list (pts md) (sep u (power (pts md)) (is-open md u)))))))))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-metrizable-top-space-def` — forall([s], is-metrizable-top-space(s) iff is-top-space(s) and forsome([md in set], is-metric-space(md) and s == [pts(md), {u in power(pts(md)): is-open(md, u)}]))

*Theorems quantifying over `is-metrizable-top-space`.*

- `hom-metrizable-top-space-id` — forall([s], is-metrizable-top-space(s) implies is-hom-metrizable-top-space(s, s, id-fun(pts(s))))
- `is-metrizable-top-space-is-set` — forall([s], is-metrizable-top-space(s) implies s in set)
- `metrizable-has-metric-top` — forall([s], is-metrizable-top-space(s) implies forsome([md], is-metric-space(md) and metric-top(md) == s))
- `rb3-metrizable-hausdorff` — forall([s], is-metrizable-top-space(s) implies is-hausdorff(s))

### module
<a id="module"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/module.scm`](../structure-library/module.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (6): `scal` substructure, a ring; `vec` carrier; `vadd` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `vzero` constant in vec; `vneg` operation vec -> vec; `act` operation cartesian(carr(scal), vec) -> vec.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-module-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-module(a, b, f) iff is-module(a) and is-module(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure module
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (property is-associative vadd vec)
  (property is-commutative vadd vec)
  (property is-identity vadd vzero vec)
  (property has-inverses vadd vzero vneg vec)
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(r_, vadd(s)(x_, y_)) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(r_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(add(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(mul(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = act(s)(r_, act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], act(s)(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_)"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-module` — forall([s], is-module(s) iff length(s) = 6 and is-ring(scal(s)) and vec(s) in set and vadd(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vzero(s) in vec(s) and vneg(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and act(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(scal(s)), vec(s)), vec(s)) and is-associative(vadd(s), vec(s)) and is-commutative(vadd(s), vec(s)) and is-identity(vadd(s), vzero(s), vec(s)) and has-inverses(vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), vec(s)) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (act(s))(r_, (vadd(s))(x_, y_)) = (vadd(s))((act(s))(r_, x_), (act(s))(r_, y_))) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))((add(scal(s)))(r_, s_), x_) = (vadd(s))((act(s))(r_, x_), (act(s))(s_, x_))) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))((mul(scal(s)))(r_, s_), x_) = (act(s))(r_, (act(s))(s_, x_))) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_) and s in set)

### monoid
<a id="monoid"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/monoid.scm`](../structure-library/monoid.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (3): `carr` carrier; `opr` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `iden` constant in carr.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-monoid-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-monoid(a, b, f) iff is-monoid(a) and is-monoid(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure monoid
  (carriers carr)
  (op opr (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (constant iden carr)
  (property is-associative opr carr)
  (property is-identity opr iden carr))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-monoid` — forall([s], is-monoid(s) iff length(s) = 3 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and s in set)

*Theorems quantifying over `is-monoid`.*

- `fact-sums-concat` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([g in fun(carr(m), rr)], forall([x in carr(m)], 0 <= g(x)) implies g(iden(m)) = 0 implies forall([x in carr(m), y in carr(m), z in carr(m)], g((opr(m))((opr(m))(x, y), z)) <= 2 * max(g(x), max(g(y), g(z)))) implies forall([n1 in nn, u1 in fun(nn, carr(m)), n2 in nn, u2 in fun(nn, carr(m))], series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(msi_, nn, g(u1(msi_))), n1) + series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(msi_, nn, g(u2(msi_))), n2) in fact-sums(m, g, (opr(m))(mprod(m, u1, n1), mprod(m, u2, n2))))))
- `fact-sums-intro` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([g in fun(carr(m), rr)], forall([x in carr(m)], 0 <= g(x)) implies g(iden(m)) = 0 implies forall([x in carr(m), y in carr(m), z in carr(m)], g((opr(m))((opr(m))(x, y), z)) <= 2 * max(g(x), max(g(y), g(z)))) implies forall([u in fun(nn, carr(m)), n in nn], series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(msi_, nn, g(u(msi_))), n) in fact-sums(m, g, mprod(m, u, n)))))
- `fact-sums-nonneg` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([g in fun(carr(m), rr)], forall([x in carr(m)], 0 <= g(x)) implies g(iden(m)) = 0 implies forall([x in carr(m), y in carr(m), z in carr(m)], g((opr(m))((opr(m))(x, y), z)) <= 2 * max(g(x), max(g(y), g(z)))) implies forall([x in carr(m)], fact-sums(m, g, x) subset rr-pos-star)))
- `hom-monoid-id` — forall([a], is-monoid(a) implies is-hom-monoid(a, a, id-fun(carr(a))))
- `is-monoid-is-set` — forall([s], is-monoid(s) implies s in set)
- `monoid-assoc` — forall([s], is-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c) = (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c))))
- `monoid-assoc-rev` — forall([s], is-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c)) = (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c)))
- `monoid-carrier-is-set` — forall([m_], is-monoid(m_) implies carr(m_) in set)
- `monoid-identity-in` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies iden(m) in carr(m))
- `monoid-left-id` — forall([s], is-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s)], (opr(s))(iden(s), a) = a))
- `monoid-left-id-rev` — forall([s], is-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s)], a = (opr(s))(iden(s), a)))
- `monoid-right-id` — forall([s], is-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a, iden(s)) = a))
- `monoid-right-id-rev` — forall([s], is-monoid(s) implies forall([a in carr(s)], a = (opr(s))(a, iden(s))))
- `mpow-add` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([x in carr(m), j in nn, k in nn], mpow(m, x, j + k) = (opr(m))(mpow(m, x, j), mpow(m, x, k))))
- `mpow-add-rev` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([x in carr(m), j in nn, k in nn], (opr(m))(mpow(m, x, j), mpow(m, x, k)) = mpow(m, x, j + k)))
- `mpow-one` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([x in carr(m)], mpow(m, x, 1) = x))
- `mpow-one-rev` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([x in carr(m)], x = mpow(m, x, 1)))
- `mpow-type` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([x in carr(m), n in nn], mpow(m, x, n) in carr(m)))
- `mprod-in-carr` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([u in fun(nn, carr(m)), n in nn], mprod(m, u, n) in carr(m)))
- `prod-ord-singleton` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(m))], prod-ord(m, f, 1) = f(0)))
- `prod-ord-singleton-rev` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(m))], f(0) = prod-ord(m, f, 1)))
- `prod-ord-type` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(m)), n in nn], prod-ord(m, f, n) in carr(m)))
- `subadd-reg-bounds` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([g in fun(carr(m), rr)], forall([x in carr(m)], 0 <= g(x)) implies g(iden(m)) = 0 implies forall([x in carr(m), y in carr(m), z in carr(m)], g((opr(m))((opr(m))(x, y), z)) <= 2 * max(g(x), max(g(y), g(z)))) implies forall([x in carr(m)], subadd-reg(m, g, x) in rr and num(1/2) * g(x) <= subadd-reg(m, g, x) and subadd-reg(m, g, x) <= g(x))))
- `subadd-reg-subadditive` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([g in fun(carr(m), rr)], forall([x in carr(m)], 0 <= g(x)) implies g(iden(m)) = 0 implies forall([x in carr(m), y in carr(m), z in carr(m)], g((opr(m))((opr(m))(x, y), z)) <= 2 * max(g(x), max(g(y), g(z)))) implies forall([x in carr(m), y in carr(m)], subadd-reg(m, g, (opr(m))(x, y)) <= subadd-reg(m, g, x) + subadd-reg(m, g, y))))

- `ring-multiplicative-monoid` — from `ring`: (carr mul one) ↦ (carr opr iden)
- `abelian-group-as-monoid` — from `abelian-group`: (carr opr iden) ↦ (carr opr iden)

### normed-ag
<a id="normed-ag"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/normed-ag.scm`](../structure-library/normed-ag.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (5): `carr` carrier; `opr` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `iden` constant in carr; `inv` operation carr -> carr; `nrm` operation carr -> rr.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-normed-ag-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-normed-ag(a, b, f) iff is-normed-ag(a) and is-normed-ag(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(iden(a)) = iden(b) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((inv(a))(x1_)) = (inv(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], (nrm(a))(x1_) = (nrm(b))(f(x1_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure normed-ag
  (carriers carr)
  (op opr (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (constant iden carr)
  (op inv carr carr)
  (op nrm carr rr)
  (property is-associative opr carr)
  (property is-identity opr iden carr)
  (property has-inverses opr iden inv carr)
  (property is-commutative opr carr)
  (property is-group-norm nrm opr inv iden carr))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-normed-ag` — forall([s], is-normed-ag(s) iff length(s) = 5 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and inv(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and nrm(s) in fun(carr(s), rr) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(opr(s), iden(s), inv(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-group-norm(nrm(s), opr(s), inv(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and s in set)

*Theorems quantifying over `is-normed-ag`.*

- `abelian-group-as-monoid-is-monoid-normed-ag-as-abelian-group` — forall([r], is-normed-ag(r) implies is-monoid(abelian-group-as-monoid(normed-ag-as-abelian-group(r))))
- `hom-normed-ag-id` — forall([a], is-normed-ag(a) implies is-hom-normed-ag(a, a, id-fun(carr(a))))
- `is-normed-ag-is-set` — forall([s], is-normed-ag(s) implies s in set)
- `nag-complete-of-norm-cauchy` — forall([nag], is-normed-ag(nag) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(nag))], forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n in nn], forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], n <= m and n <= n_ implies (nrm(nag))((opr(nag))(f(m), (inv(nag))(f(n_)))) <= eps))) implies forsome([l in carr(nag)], forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n in nn], forall([n_ in nn], n <= n_ implies (nrm(nag))((opr(nag))(f(n_), (inv(nag))(l))) <= eps))))) implies is-complete(nag-metric-space(nag)))
- `nag-complete-of-summable-increments` — forall([grp], is-normed-ag(grp) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(grp)), rad in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(rad) implies forall([k in nn], (nrm(grp))((opr(grp))(f(k), (inv(grp))(f(succ(k))))) <= rad(k)) implies converges(nag-metric-space(grp), f)) implies is-complete(nag-metric-space(grp)))

### normed-field
<a id="normed-field"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/normed-field.scm`](../structure-library/normed-field.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (7): `carr` carrier; `add` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `mul` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `neg` operation carr -> carr; `zero` constant in carr; `one` constant in carr; `fnrm` operation carr -> rr.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-normed-field-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-normed-field(a, b, f) iff is-normed-field(a) and is-normed-field(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((add(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (add(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((mul(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (mul(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], f((neg(a))(x1_)) = (neg(b))(f(x1_))) and f(zero(a)) = zero(b) and f(one(a)) = one(b) and forall([x1_ in carr(a)], (fnrm(a))(x1_) = (fnrm(b))(f(x1_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure normed-field
  (instance-var s)
  (carriers carr)
  (op add (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (op mul (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (op neg carr carr)
  (constant zero carr)
  (constant one carr)
  (op fnrm carr rr)
  (property is-associative add carr)
  (property is-commutative add carr)
  (property is-identity add zero carr)
  (property has-inverses add zero neg carr)
  (property is-associative mul carr)
  (property is-commutative mul carr)
  (property is-identity mul one carr)
  (property is-distributive add mul carr)
  (property is-norm fnrm add mul zero carr)
  (law "not(zero(s) = one(s))")
  (law "forall([a_ in carr(s)],
          not(a_ = zero(s)) implies
            forsome([b_ in carr(s)], not(b_ = zero(s)) and mul(s)(a_, b_) = one(s)))"))
```

- `is-normed-field` — forall([s], is-normed-field(s) iff length(s) = 7 and carr(s) in set and add(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and mul(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and neg(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and zero(s) in carr(s) and one(s) in carr(s) and fnrm(s) in fun(carr(s), rr) and is-associative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(add(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(add(s), zero(s), neg(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(mul(s), one(s), carr(s)) and is-distributive(add(s), mul(s), carr(s)) and is-norm(fnrm(s), add(s), mul(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and not(zero(s) = one(s)) and forall([a_ in carr(s)], not(a_ = zero(s)) implies forsome([b_ in carr(s)], not(b_ = zero(s)) and (mul(s))(a_, b_) = one(s))) and s in set)

### normed-vector-space
<a id="normed-vector-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/normed-vector-space.scm`](../structure-library/normed-vector-space.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (7): `scal` substructure, a ring; `vec` carrier; `vadd` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `vzero` constant in vec; `vneg` operation vec -> vec; `act` operation cartesian(carr(scal), vec) -> vec; `vnrm` operation vec -> rr.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-normed-vector-space-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-normed-vector-space(a, b, f) iff is-normed-vector-space(a) and is-normed-vector-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(x1_) = (vnrm(b))(f(x1_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure normed-vector-space
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (op vnrm vec rr)
  (property is-associative vadd vec)
  (property is-commutative vadd vec)
  (property is-identity vadd vzero vec)
  (property has-inverses vadd vzero vneg vec)
  (law "scal(s) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field)")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(r_, vadd(s)(x_, y_)) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(r_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(add(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(mul(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = act(s)(r_, act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], act(s)(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], 0 <= vnrm(s)(x_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s)(x_) = 0) iff (x_ = vzero(s)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          vnrm(s)(act(s)(r_, x_)) = abs(r_) * vnrm(s)(x_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          vnrm(s)(vadd(s)(x_, y_)) <= vnrm(s)(x_) + vnrm(s)(y_))"))
```

### nu-c-star-algebra
<a id="nu-c-star-algebra"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/ba-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/ba-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as nu-involutive-banach-algebra)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`nu-involutive-banach-algebra`](#nu-involutive-banach-algebra).  Shape inherited from `nu-involutive-banach-algebra` — slots (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act vnrm vmul istar).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure nu-c-star-algebra
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as nu-involutive-banach-algebra)
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], vnrm(s)(vmul(s)(istar(s)(x_), x_)) = vnrm(s)(x_) * vnrm(s)(x_))"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-nu-c-star-algebra-def` — forall([s], is-nu-c-star-algebra(s) iff is-nu-involutive-banach-algebra(s) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s))((vmul(s))((istar(s))(x_), x_)) = (vnrm(s))(x_) * (vnrm(s))(x_)))

*Theorems quantifying over `is-nu-c-star-algebra`.*

- `is-nu-c-star-algebra-is-set` — forall([s], is-nu-c-star-algebra(s) implies s in set)

### nu-involutive-banach-algebra
<a id="nu-involutive-banach-algebra"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/ba-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/ba-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (9): `scal` substructure, a ring; `vec` carrier; `vadd` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `vzero` constant in vec; `vneg` operation vec -> vec; `act` operation cartesian(carr(scal), vec) -> vec; `vnrm` operation vec -> rr; `vmul` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `istar` operation vec -> vec.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-nu-involutive-banach-algebra-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-nu-involutive-banach-algebra(a, b, f) iff is-nu-involutive-banach-algebra(a) and is-nu-involutive-banach-algebra(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(x1_) = (vnrm(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vmul(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vmul(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((istar(a))(x1_)) = (istar(b))(f(x1_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure nu-involutive-banach-algebra
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (op vnrm vec rr)
  (op vmul (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (op istar vec vec)
  (law "is-complex-banach-algebra([scal(s), vec(s), vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), act(s), vnrm(s), vmul(s)])")
  (law "carr(scal(s)) = cc")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], istar(s)(vadd(s)(x_, y_)) = vadd(s)(istar(s)(x_), istar(s)(y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in cc, x_ in vec(s)], istar(s)(act(s)(r_, x_)) = act(s)(conjugate(r_), istar(s)(x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], istar(s)(istar(s)(x_)) = x_)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], istar(s)(vmul(s)(x_, y_)) = vmul(s)(istar(s)(y_), istar(s)(x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], vnrm(s)(istar(s)(x_)) = vnrm(s)(x_))"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-nu-involutive-banach-algebra` — forall([s], is-nu-involutive-banach-algebra(s) iff length(s) = 9 and is-ring(scal(s)) and vec(s) in set and vadd(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vzero(s) in vec(s) and vneg(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and act(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(scal(s)), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vnrm(s) in fun(vec(s), rr) and vmul(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and istar(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and is-complex-banach-algebra([scal(s), vec(s), vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), act(s), vnrm(s), vmul(s)]) and carr(scal(s)) = cc and forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (istar(s))((vadd(s))(x_, y_)) = (vadd(s))((istar(s))(x_), (istar(s))(y_))) and forall([r_ in cc, x_ in vec(s)], (istar(s))((act(s))(r_, x_)) = (act(s))(conjugate(r_), (istar(s))(x_))) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (istar(s))((istar(s))(x_)) = x_) and forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (istar(s))((vmul(s))(x_, y_)) = (vmul(s))((istar(s))(y_), (istar(s))(x_))) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s))((istar(s))(x_)) = (vnrm(s))(x_)) and s in set)

### pid
<a id="pid"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/ideal.scm`](../structure-library/ideal.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as integral-domain)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`integral-domain`](#integral-domain).  Shape inherited from `integral-domain` — slots (carr add mul neg zero one).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure pid
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as integral-domain)
  (law "forall([i in set], is-ideal(s, i) implies
          forsome([a in carr(s)], i = principal-ideal(s, a)))"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-pid-def` — forall([s], is-pid(s) iff is-integral-domain(s) and forall([i in set], is-ideal(s, i) implies forsome([a in carr(s)], i = principal-ideal(s, a))))

*Theorems quantifying over `is-pid`.*

- `hom-pid-id` — forall([a], is-pid(a) implies is-hom-pid(a, a, id-fun(carr(a))))
- `is-pid-is-set` — forall([s], is-pid(s) implies s in set)

### pk-space
<a id="pk-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/nsl.scm`](../structure-library/nsl.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (3): `pk-inf` substructure, a infiltrated-space; `names` carrier; `pubkey` operation names -> keys(ispace(pk-inf)).

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-pk-space-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-pk-space(a, b, f) iff is-pk-space(a) and is-pk-space(b) and f in fun(names(a), names(b)) and pk-inf(a) = pk-inf(b) and forall([x1_ in names(a)], (pubkey(a))(x1_) = (pubkey(b))(f(x1_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure pk-space
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure pk-inf infiltrated-space)
  (carriers names)
  (op pubkey names (keys (ispace pk-inf)))
  (law (forall nlx_ (implies (in nlx_ (names s)) (in nlx_ (tokens (ispace (pk-inf s)))))))
  (law (forall nlx_ (implies (in nlx_ (names s)) (not (in nlx_ (keys (ispace (pk-inf s))))))))
  (law (forall nlx_ (forall nly_ (implies (in nlx_ (names s)) (implies (in nly_ (names s)) (implies (= ((pubkey s) nlx_) ((pubkey s) nly_)) (= nlx_ nly_))))))))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-pk-space` — forall([s], is-pk-space(s) iff length(s) = 3 and is-infiltrated-space(pk-inf(s)) and names(s) in set and pubkey(s) in fun(names(s), keys(ispace(pk-inf(s)))) and forall([nlx_ in names(s)], nlx_ in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(s)))) and forall([nlx_ in names(s)], not(nlx_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(s))))) and forall([nlx_, nly_], nlx_ in names(s) implies nly_ in names(s) implies (pubkey(s))(nlx_) = (pubkey(s))(nly_) implies nlx_ = nly_) and s in set)

*Theorems quantifying over `is-pk-space`.*

- `is-pk-space-is-set` — forall([s], is-pk-space(s) implies s in set)
- `pk-space-parts` — forall([nsp], is-pk-space(nsp) implies is-infiltrated-space(pk-inf(nsp)) and is-strand-space(ispace(pk-inf(nsp))) and names(nsp) in set and pubkey(nsp) in fun(names(nsp), keys(ispace(pk-inf(nsp)))) and forall([x in names(nsp)], x in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(nsp)))) and forall([x in names(nsp)], not(x in keys(ispace(pk-inf(nsp))))) and forall([x, y], x in names(nsp) implies y in names(nsp) implies (pubkey(nsp))(x) = (pubkey(nsp))(y) implies x = y))

### pre-hilbert-space
<a id="pre-hilbert-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/sip-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/sip-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as semi-inner-product-space)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`semi-inner-product-space`](#semi-inner-product-space).  Shape inherited from `semi-inner-product-space` — slots (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act rip).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure pre-hilbert-space
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as semi-inner-product-space)
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], rip(s)(x_, x_) = 0 implies x_ = vzero(s))"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-pre-hilbert-space-def` — forall([s], is-pre-hilbert-space(s) iff is-semi-inner-product-space(s) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (rip(s))(x_, x_) = 0 implies x_ = vzero(s)))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure pseudometric-space
  (carriers pts)
  (op dist (cartesian pts pts) rr)
  (property is-pseudometric dist pts))
```

### ring
<a id="ring"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/ring.scm`](../structure-library/ring.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (6): `carr` carrier; `add` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `mul` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `neg` operation carr -> carr; `zero` constant in carr; `one` constant in carr.

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure ring
  (carriers carr)
  (op add (cartesian carr carr) carr)

  (property is-associative mul carr)
  (property is-identity mul one carr)
  (property is-distributive add mul carr))
```

### ringoid
<a id="ringoid"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/ringoid.scm`](../structure-library/ringoid.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (7): `carr` carrier; `add` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `mul` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr; `neg` operation carr -> carr; `zero` constant in carr; `one` constant in carr; `idl` constant in power(carr).

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-ringoid-def`, replaced by `declare-hom!`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-ringoid(a, b, f) iff is-ringoid(a) and is-ringoid(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and is-hom-ring(ringoid-as-ring(a), ringoid-as-ring(b), f) and forall([x_ in idl(a)], f(x_) in idl(b)))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure ringoid
  (carriers carr)
  (op add (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (op mul (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (op neg carr carr)
  (constant zero carr)
  (constant one carr)
  (constant idl (power carr))
  (property is-associative add carr)
  (property is-commutative add carr)
  (property is-identity add zero carr)
  (property has-inverses add zero neg carr)
  (property is-associative mul carr)
  (property is-identity mul one carr)
  (property is-distributive add mul carr)
  (property is-ideal-in idl carr add mul neg zero))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-ringoid` — forall([s], is-ringoid(s) iff length(s) = 7 and carr(s) in set and add(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and mul(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and neg(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and zero(s) in carr(s) and one(s) in carr(s) and idl(s) in power(carr(s)) and is-associative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(add(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(add(s), zero(s), neg(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(mul(s), one(s), carr(s)) and is-distributive(add(s), mul(s), carr(s)) and is-ideal-in(idl(s), carr(s), add(s), mul(s), neg(s), zero(s)) and s in set)

### semi-inner-product-space
<a id="semi-inner-product-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/sip-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/sip-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (7): `scal` substructure, a ring; `vec` carrier; `vadd` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `vzero` constant in vec; `vneg` operation vec -> vec; `act` operation cartesian(carr(scal), vec) -> vec; `rip` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> rr.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-semi-inner-product-space-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-semi-inner-product-space(a, b, f) iff is-semi-inner-product-space(a) and is-semi-inner-product-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], (rip(a))(x1_, x2_) = (rip(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure semi-inner-product-space
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (op rip (cartesian vec vec) rr)
  (property is-associative vadd vec)
  (property is-commutative vadd vec)
  (property is-identity vadd vzero vec)
  (property has-inverses vadd vzero vneg vec)
  (law "scal(s) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field)")
  (law "carr(scal(s)) = rr")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(r_, vadd(s)(x_, y_)) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(r_, y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(add(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = vadd(s)(act(s)(r_, x_), act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)],
          act(s)(mul(scal(s))(r_, s_), x_) = act(s)(r_, act(s)(s_, x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], act(s)(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], rip(s)(x_, y_) = rip(s)(y_, x_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s), z_ in vec(s)],
          rip(s)(vadd(s)(x_, y_), z_) = rip(s)(x_, z_) + rip(s)(y_, z_))")
  (law "forall([a_ in rr, x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)],
          rip(s)(act(s)(a_, x_), y_) = a_ * rip(s)(x_, y_))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], 0 <= rip(s)(x_, x_))"))
```

- `sipq-vneg-computes-rev` — forall([v], is-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([a_ in vec(v)], class(sip-setoid(v), (vneg(v))(a_)) = (vneg(sip-quotient(v)))(class(sip-setoid(v), a_))))
- `sipq-vneg-fun` — forall([v], is-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies vneg(sip-quotient(v)) in fun(vec(sip-quotient(v)), vec(sip-quotient(v))))
- `sipq-vneg-rev` — forall([v], is-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies sip-qvneg(v) == vneg(sip-quotient(v)))
- `sipq-vzero` — forall([v], is-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies vzero(sip-quotient(v)) == class(sip-setoid(v), vzero(v)))
- `sipq-vzero-in` — forall([v], is-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies vzero(sip-quotient(v)) in vec(sip-quotient(v)))
- `sipq-vzero-rev` — forall([v], is-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies class(sip-setoid(v), vzero(v)) == vzero(sip-quotient(v)))
- `span-is-submodule-sip-as-module` — forall([r], is-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([n, u in mat(n, 1, vec(r))], is-submodule(sip-as-module(r), span(sip-as-module(r), n, u))))
- `spans-coeff-matrix-sip-as-module` — forall([r], is-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([n, m, xs, ys, sm], xs in mat(n, 1, vec(r)) implies ys in mat(m, 1, vec(r)) implies (n = 0 implies m = 0) implies spans(sip-as-module(r), n, xs, sm) implies forall([j_ in interval(1, m)], entry(ys, j_, 1) in sm) implies forsome([cm in mat(m, n, carr(scal(r)))], ys = matact(sip-as-module(r), cm, xs))))
- `spans-rel-free-transitive-sip-as-module` — forall([r], is-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([n, xs, ys, sm], xs in mat(n, 1, vec(r)) implies ys in mat(n, 1, vec(r)) implies spans(sip-as-module(r), n, xs, sm) implies rel-free(sip-as-module(r), n, xs) implies spans(sip-as-module(r), n, ys, sm) implies rel-free(sip-as-module(r), n, ys) implies forsome([pm], is-invertible-mat(scal(r), n, pm) and ys = matact(sip-as-module(r), pm, xs))))
- `spans-span-sip-as-module` — forall([r], is-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([n, u in mat(n, 1, vec(r))], spans(sip-as-module(r), n, u, span(sip-as-module(r), n, u))))

- `submodule-finsum-closed-sip-as-module` — forall([r], is-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(sip-as-module(r), sm) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(module-vector-ag(sip-as-module(r))))], forall([z in s], f(z) in sm) implies finsum(module-vector-ag(sip-as-module(r)), f, s) in sm))))
- `submodule-intersection-sip-as-module` — forall([r], is-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies forall([s1], is-submodule(sip-as-module(r), s1) implies forall([s2], is-submodule(sip-as-module(r), s2) implies is-submodule(sip-as-module(r), intersection(s1, s2)))))

- `submodule-norm-value-sip-as-module` — forall([r], is-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies scal(r) = zz-ring implies forall([sm, n, xs, ys, am], is-norm-data(sip-as-module(r), sm, n, xs, ys, am) implies submodule-norm(sip-as-module(r), sm) = abs(det(zz-ring, n, am))))
