### semigroup
<a id="semigroup"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/semigroup.scm`](../structure-library/semigroup.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (2): `carr` carrier; `opr` operation cartesian(carr, carr) -> carr.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-semigroup-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-semigroup(a, b, f) iff is-semigroup(a) and is-semigroup(b) and f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and forall([x1_ in carr(a), x2_ in carr(a)], f((opr(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (opr(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure semigroup
  (carriers carr)
  (op opr (cartesian carr carr) carr)
  (property is-associative opr carr))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-semigroup` — forall([s], is-semigroup(s) iff length(s) = 2 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and s in set)

*Theorems quantifying over `is-semigroup`.*

- `hom-semigroup-id` — forall([a], is-semigroup(a) implies is-hom-semigroup(a, a, id-fun(carr(a))))
- `is-semigroup-is-set` — forall([s], is-semigroup(s) implies s in set)
- `semigroup-assoc` — forall([s], is-semigroup(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c) = (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c))))
- `semigroup-assoc-rev` — forall([s], is-semigroup(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c)) = (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c)))

### setoid
<a id="setoid"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/setoid.scm`](../structure-library/setoid.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (2): `pts` carrier; `rel` relation on pts.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-setoid-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-setoid(a, b, f) iff is-setoid(a) and is-setoid(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forall([x1_ in pts(a), x2_ in pts(a)], [x1_, x2_] in rel(a) implies [f(x1_), f(x2_)] in rel(b)))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure setoid
  (carriers pts)
  (relation rel pts)
  (property is-equivalence rel pts))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-setoid` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and rel(s) in power(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s))) and is-equivalence(rel(s), pts(s)) and s in set)

*Theorems quantifying over `is-setoid`.*

- `class-disjoint` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a in pts(s), b in pts(s)], class(s, a) = class(s, b) or intersection(class(s, a), class(s, b)) = empty-set))
- `class-eq-iff` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a in pts(s), b in pts(s)], class(s, a) = class(s, b) iff related(s, a, b)))
- `class-eq-iff-rev` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a in pts(s), b in pts(s)], related(s, a, b) iff class(s, a) = class(s, b)))
- `class-in-quotient` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a in pts(s)], class(s, a) in quotient(s)))
- `class-is-set` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a in pts(s)], class(s, a) in set))
- `class-of-member` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([cq_ in quotient(s), a in cq_], a in pts(s) and class(s, a) = cq_))
- `class-self` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a in pts(s)], a in class(s, a)))
- `class-subset-carrier` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a in pts(s)], class(s, a) subset pts(s)))
- `descend-computes` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([z, f], f in fun(pts(s), z) and respects(s, f) implies forall([a in pts(s)], (descend(s, f))(class(s, a)) = f(a))))
- `descend-computes-rev` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([z, f], f in fun(pts(s), z) and respects(s, f) implies forall([a in pts(s)], f(a) = (descend(s, f))(class(s, a)))))
- `descend-in-fun` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([z, f], f in fun(pts(s), z) and respects(s, f) implies descend(s, f) in fun(quotient(s), z)))
- `descend2-computes` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([z, f in fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), z)], respects2(s, f) implies forall([a, b], a in pts(s) implies b in pts(s) implies (descend2(s, f))(class(s, a), class(s, b)) = f(a, b))))
- `descend2-computes-rev` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([z, f in fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), z)], respects2(s, f) implies forall([a, b], a in pts(s) implies b in pts(s) implies f(a, b) = (descend2(s, f))(class(s, a), class(s, b)))))
- `descend2-in-fun` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([z, f in fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), z)], respects2(s, f) implies descend2(s, f) in fun(cartesian(quotient(s), quotient(s)), z)))
- `hom-setoid-id` — forall([a], is-setoid(a) implies is-hom-setoid(a, a, id-fun(pts(a))))
- `is-setoid-is-set` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies s in set)
- `proj-in-fun` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies proj(s) in fun(pts(s), quotient(s)))
- `quotient-is-set` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies quotient(s) in set)
- `quotient-member-choice` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([cq_ in quotient(s)], choice(cq_) in cq_))
- `quotient-rep` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([x in quotient(s)], forsome([a in pts(s)], x = class(s, a))))
- `quotient-universal` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([z, f], f in fun(pts(s), z) and respects(s, f) implies forsome([g in fun(quotient(s), z)], forall([a in pts(s)], g(class(s, a)) = f(a)) and forall([g_], g_ in fun(quotient(s), z) and forall([a in pts(s)], g_(class(s, a)) = f(a)) implies g_ = g))))
- `rko2-refl` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a_ in pts(s)], related(s, a_, a_)))
- `rko2-sym` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a_, b_], a_ in pts(s) implies b_ in pts(s) implies related(s, a_, b_) implies related(s, b_, a_)))
- `rko2-trans` — forall([s], is-setoid(s) implies forall([a_, b_, c_], a_ in pts(s) implies b_ in pts(s) implies c_ in pts(s) implies related(s, a_, b_) implies related(s, b_, c_) implies related(s, a_, c_)))

### sk-space
<a id="sk-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/otway-rees.scm`](../structure-library/otway-rees.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (3): `sk-inf` substructure, a infiltrated-space; `sk-names` carrier; `ltkey` operation sk-names -> keys(ispace(sk-inf)).

### unital-banach-algebra
<a id="unital-banach-algebra"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/ba-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/ba-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (9): `scal` substructure, a ring; `vec` carrier; `vadd` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `vzero` constant in vec; `vneg` operation vec -> vec; `act` operation cartesian(carr(scal), vec) -> vec; `vnrm` operation vec -> rr; `vmul` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `vone` constant in vec.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-unital-banach-algebra-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-unital-banach-algebra(a, b, f) iff is-unital-banach-algebra(a) and is-unital-banach-algebra(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(x1_) = (vnrm(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vmul(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vmul(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vone(a)) = vone(b))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure unital-banach-algebra
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (op vnrm vec rr)
  (op vmul (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vone vec)
  (law "is-complex-banach-algebra([scal(s), vec(s), vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), act(s), vnrm(s), vmul(s)])")
  (law "carr(scal(s)) = cc")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], vmul(s)(vone(s), x_) = x_)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], vmul(s)(x_, vone(s)) = x_)")
  (law "vnrm(s)(vone(s)) = 1"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-unital-banach-algebra` — forall([s], is-unital-banach-algebra(s) iff length(s) = 9 and is-ring(scal(s)) and vec(s) in set and vadd(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vzero(s) in vec(s) and vneg(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and act(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(scal(s)), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vnrm(s) in fun(vec(s), rr) and vmul(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vone(s) in vec(s) and is-complex-banach-algebra([scal(s), vec(s), vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), act(s), vnrm(s), vmul(s)]) and carr(scal(s)) = cc and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vmul(s))(vone(s), x_) = x_) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vmul(s))(x_, vone(s)) = x_) and (vnrm(s))(vone(s)) = 1 and s in set)

(declare-structure unital-c-star-algebra

### unital-involutive-banach-algebra
<a id="unital-involutive-banach-algebra"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/ba-vocab.scm`](../structure-library/ba-vocab.scm).

*Kind.* Shape structure — `declare-structure` with slot clauses.

*Slots* (10): `scal` substructure, a ring; `vec` carrier; `vadd` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `vzero` constant in vec; `vneg` operation vec -> vec; `act` operation cartesian(carr(scal), vec) -> vec; `vnrm` operation vec -> rr; `vmul` operation cartesian(vec, vec) -> vec; `vone` constant in vec; `vstar` operation vec -> vec.

*Default arrows* (`is-hom-unital-involutive-banach-algebra-def`): forall([a, b, f], is-hom-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a, b, f) iff is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a) and is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vzero(a)) = vzero(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vneg(a))(x1_)) = (vneg(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(x1_) = (vnrm(b))(f(x1_))) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vmul(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vmul(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and f(vone(a)) = vone(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], f((vstar(a))(x1_)) = (vstar(b))(f(x1_))))

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure unital-involutive-banach-algebra
  (instance-var s)
  (substructure scal ring)
  (carriers vec)
  (op vadd (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vzero vec)
  (op vneg vec vec)
  (op act (cartesian (carr scal) vec) vec)
  (op vnrm vec rr)
  (op vmul (cartesian vec vec) vec)
  (constant vone vec)
  (op vstar vec vec)
  (law "is-unital-banach-algebra([scal(s), vec(s), vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), act(s), vnrm(s), vmul(s), vone(s)])")
  (law "carr(scal(s)) = cc")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], vstar(s)(vadd(s)(x_, y_)) = vadd(s)(vstar(s)(x_), vstar(s)(y_)))")
  (law "forall([r_ in cc, x_ in vec(s)], vstar(s)(act(s)(r_, x_)) = act(s)(conjugate(r_), vstar(s)(x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], vstar(s)(vstar(s)(x_)) = x_)")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], vstar(s)(vmul(s)(x_, y_)) = vmul(s)(vstar(s)(y_), vstar(s)(x_)))")
  (law "forall([x_ in vec(s)], vnrm(s)(vstar(s)(x_)) = vnrm(s)(x_))"))
```

### vector-space
<a id="vector-space"></a>

*Declared in* [`structure-library/finite-dimensional.scm`](../structure-library/finite-dimensional.scm).

*Kind.* Refinement — `declare-structure` with `(same-shape-as module)`; its `IS-X <=> IS-PARENT and <laws>` axiom is generated, not hand-written.  Subtype of [`module`](#module).  Shape inherited from `module` — slots (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act).

*Declaration.*

```scheme
(declare-structure vector-space
  (instance-var s)
  (same-shape-as module)
  (law "is-field-ring(scal(s))"))
```

*Defining predicate* (as stored):

- `is-vector-space-def` — forall([s], is-vector-space(s) iff is-module(s) and is-field-ring(scal(s)))

*Theorems quantifying over `is-vector-space`.*

- `cayley-hamilton-cyclic` — forall([md], is-vector-space(md) implies forall([tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([v], is-cyclic-vector(md, tt, v) implies forall([nv_ in nn], 1 <= nv_ implies forall([av_], forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], av_(i_) in carr(scal(md))) implies is-annihilating-poly(md, tt, v, monic-poly(scal(md), av_, nv_)) implies forall([a], is-matrix-of(md, nv_, krylov(md, tt, v, nv_), tt, a) implies char-poly(scal(md), a, nv_) = monic-poly(scal(md), av_, nv_) and forall([w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, char-poly(scal(md), a, nv_), w) = vzero(md))))))))
- `cyclic-vector-companion` — forall([md], is-vector-space(md) implies forall([tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([v], is-cyclic-vector(md, tt, v) implies forall([nv_ in nn], 1 <= nv_ implies forall([av_], forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], av_(i_) in carr(scal(md))) implies is-annihilating-poly(md, tt, v, monic-poly(scal(md), av_, nv_)) implies generates(md, nv_, krylov(md, tt, v, nv_)) and rel-free(md, nv_, krylov(md, tt, v, nv_)) and is-matrix-of(md, nv_, krylov(md, tt, v, nv_), tt, companion(scal(md), av_, nv_)) and is-minimal-poly(md, tt, monic-poly(scal(md), av_, nv_)))))))
- `hom-vector-space-id` — forall([a], is-vector-space(a) implies is-hom-vector-space(a, a, id-fun(vec(a))))
- `is-vector-space-is-set` — forall([s], is-vector-space(s) implies s in set)
- `nilpotent-cyclic-vector` — forall([md], is-vector-space(md) implies forall([tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-nilpotent-op(md, tt) implies forall([v], is-cyclic-vector(md, tt, v) implies forall([k], is-annihilating-poly(md, tt, v, k) implies 1 <= deg(scal(md), k) implies k = monic-poly(scal(md), vnb-lambda(gzi_, interval(1, deg(scal(md), k)), zero(scal(md))), deg(scal(md), k)) and generates(md, deg(scal(md), k), krylov(md, tt, v, deg(scal(md), k))) and rel-free(md, deg(scal(md), k), krylov(md, tt, v, deg(scal(md), k))) and is-matrix-of(md, deg(scal(md), k), krylov(md, tt, v, deg(scal(md), k)), tt, companion(scal(md), vnb-lambda(gzi_, interval(1, deg(scal(md), k)), zero(scal(md))), deg(scal(md), k))) and is-minimal-poly(md, tt, k)))))
- `vspace-vec-is-set` — forall([m], is-vector-space(m) implies vec(m) in set)

## View-as declarations (alphabetical)

A view-as is a *forgetful functor* between structure categories, in exactly two cases: it forgets **shape** (keeps a sub-list of the source's slots) and/or forgets **properties** (the target's laws are fewer than the source's).  The slot map below is written in the *target's* coordinates: position k shows which source accessor fills the target's k-th slot.  Non-forgetful functors (quotient, completion) are constructions, not views.

- `abelian-group-as-monoid` — `abelian-group` → `monoid`: (carr opr iden) ↦ (carr opr iden)
- `cna-as-module` — `complex-normed-algebra` → `module`: (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act) ↦ (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act)
- `cna-as-normed-ag` — `complex-normed-algebra` → `normed-ag`: (vec vadd vzero vneg vnrm) ↦ (carr opr iden inv nrm)
- `cnvs-as-module` — `complex-normed-vector-space` → `module`: (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act) ↦ (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act)
- `cnvs-as-normed-ag` — `complex-normed-vector-space` → `normed-ag`: (vec vadd vzero vneg vnrm) ↦ (carr opr iden inv nrm)
- `cnvs-as-nvs` — `complex-normed-vector-space` → `normed-vector-space`: (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act vnrm) ↦ (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act vnrm)
- `commutative-ring-additive-ag` — `commutative-ring` → `abelian-group`: (carr add zero neg) ↦ (carr opr iden inv)
- `commutative-ring-multiplicative-cm` — `commutative-ring` → `comm-monoid`: (carr mul one) ↦ (carr opr iden)
- `complex-inner-product-space-as-module` — `complex-inner-product-space` → `module`: (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act) ↦ (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act)
- `csip-as-sip` — `complex-semi-inner-product-space` → `semi-inner-product-space`: (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act rip) ↦ (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act rip)
- `field-additive-ag` — `field` → `abelian-group`: (carr add zero neg) ↦ (carr opr iden inv)
- `field-as-euclidean-ring` — `field` → `euclidean-ring`: (carr add mul neg zero one) ↦ (carr add mul neg zero one)
- `field-as-integral-domain` — `field` → `integral-domain`: (carr add mul neg zero one) ↦ (carr add mul neg zero one)
- `field-multiplicative-group` — `field` → `group`: (non-zero mul one mul-inv) ↦ (carr opr iden inv)
- `measure-space-as-measurable-space` — `measure-space` → `measurable-space`: (pts sigma) ↦ (pts sigma)
- `module-vector-ag` — `module` → `abelian-group`: (vec vadd vzero vneg) ↦ (carr opr iden inv)
- `normed-ag-as-abelian-group` — `normed-ag` → `abelian-group`: (carr opr iden inv) ↦ (carr opr iden inv)

- `normed-field-as-commutative-ring` — `normed-field` → `commutative-ring`: (carr add mul neg zero one) ↦ (carr add mul neg zero one)
- `normed-field-as-integral-domain` — `normed-field` → `integral-domain`: (carr add mul neg zero one) ↦ (carr add mul neg zero one)
- `normed-vector-space-as-module` — `normed-vector-space` → `module`: (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act) ↦ (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act)
- `normed-vector-space-as-normed-ag` — `normed-vector-space` → `normed-ag`: (vec vadd vzero vneg vnrm) ↦ (carr opr iden inv nrm)
- `nuiba-as-cba` — `nu-involutive-banach-algebra` → `complex-banach-algebra`: (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act vnrm vmul) ↦ (scal vec vadd vzero vneg act vnrm vmul)
